title: POST /v1/projects/{projectId}/import-uploads response
description: Contract addition 2026-11-23 (integration, see ../contract-additions.md): multipart upload of one reference file (form field file, filename extension .ris, .bib, .bibtex or .csv), 1 byte to 5 MiB. Owner, editor or analyst only (same gate as POST /imports). The API stores the bytes in private R2 at projects/{projectId}/imports/{sha256}.{ext} and returns the storageKey; the screen then calls POST /v1/projects/{projectId}/imports with {format, storageKey}. Content parsing happens in the import step, not here. Re-uploading identical bytes reuses the same key. Audit event: import_uploaded. Errors: 400 invalid_multipart / missing_file, 413 file_size, 415 file_type, 403 not_member (role too weak), 404 project_not_found (unknown project or non-member), 503 storage_unavailable (no R2 binding).
